M04-AC01.statement: All 140 owning numeric/syntax fixtures pass; incorrect sign, value, unit, version or skill-token changes are rejected.
M04-AC01.evidence: tests/v2/normalization/test_normalize_numbers.py (80/80 exact, 16 negative controls) and test_normalize_syntax.py (60/60 exact, 18 negative controls) on post-review code; invalid octets/days/versions surface as rejected proposals with reasons (invalid_octet, invalid_day, invalid_version, unanchored_version) and are never applied; protected values carry typed value+unit evidence.

M04-AC02.statement: Explicit literal and non-command counterexamples remain unconverted.
M04-AC02.evidence: test_normalize_syntax.py::test_literal_and_noncommand_stay_unconverted plus the 34 negative-control fixtures across both files (prose guards: 'one of the reasons', 'the number one reason', 'a dash of salt', 'the period of adjustment', 'fourth period', noun compounds 'grace/trial period', quantified scales 'a few hundred people', 'slash the budget', 'the dot com era', quoted instructions).

M04-AC03.statement: Applying normalization twice produces identical text and no duplicate changes.
M04-AC03.evidence: test_normalize_numbers.py::test_idempotence_all_fixtures and test_normalize_syntax.py::test_idempotence_all_fixtures assert f(f(x))==f(x) with an empty second ledger on all 140 fixtures. Two fixtures (LF-SYN-003, LF-SYN-005) declare idempotence_expected:false — the documented literal-escape corner (an escape emitting a bare command word/phrase re-matches its command grammar on a second full pass); is_idempotent() reports False for them honestly (test_normalize_syntax.py::test_escape_corner_reported_honestly) and the pipeline re-normalizes only raw ASR output, never normalized text.

M04-AC04.statement: No parser path invokes a shell, sends Enter or executes a discovered skill.
M04-AC04.evidence: test_normalize_syntax.py::test_no_shell_no_enter_no_skill_execution: word-boundary static scan of all 7 package modules against banned tokens (subprocess/os.system/os.popen/eval(/exec(/__import__/importlib/ctypes/os.exec/os.spawn/os.fork/pty/from subprocess/CGEvent/Quartz/open(/urllib/requests/socket/http) with a non-empty-scan guard naming the expected modules, plus module-namespace import checks and a behavioral proof that emitting /brainstorm produces text only. Review note: the original scan computed its path one level too high and passed vacuously (CA1 critical); fixed with parents[3] + the module-set assertion — verified to scan 7 files.

M04-AC05.statement: Each normalization result can be replayed from retained input, policy and ledger; number-word-to-digit changes are scored separately from lexical ASR.
M04-AC05.evidence: test_normalize_numbers.py::test_ledger_replay (all 80 fixtures replay byte-exact); test_normalization_pipeline.py::test_evidence_envelope_and_ledger_replay (ledger artifact + raw transcript artifact replay through the real store with consent enabled); scoring.separate_scores counts number-word-to-digit edits apart from other edits (test_short_command_scoring.py); span_types.NUMERIC_CLASSES drives the separate counting and training.py records number_word_to_digit_count in the envelope.

M04-AC06.statement: Short/literal command controls cannot convert ordinary slash prose into an unintended registered token.
M04-AC06.evidence: test_normalize_syntax.py::test_slash_prose_never_converts ('slash the budget', 'slash brainstorms', 'budget slash spending', 'slash brainstorming ideas', 'we should slash costs and brainstorm' with a populated registry) and test_short_command_scoring.py (false-command rate 0/8 on non-command controls).

C3 (CA1): the AC04 static scan computed its package path one level too high (tests/localflow/... nonexistent) and passed vacuously, masked by policy.py's 'open(' — path fixed to parents[3], policy loader switched to Path.read_text, non-empty-scan assertion naming the 7 expected modules added; verified the scan now actually scans.
W1: app.py policy-fallback could itself raise on a corrupt policy file, crashing startup — fallback is now None + guarded call sites + honest pipeline_info omission.
W2: unanchored time grammar converted ordinal speech ('chapter five thirty two' → 'chapter 5:32') — time grammar now gated on utterance-initial position or a time preposition; regression test.

W4: is_idempotent evaluated without the pass-1 context and read a private attr; evaluation failure left an unexplained null — context now passed through, public idempotence accessor added, idempotent_reason recorded (null-with-reason).

W5: envelope per-edit values carried transcript-derived PII strings (emails, paths, skill tokens) that would outlive the leased artifacts — envelope values now restricted to typed numeric/date/time classes (_VALUE_SAFE_CLASSES); string-valued classes keep their strings in the ledger artifact only.
W6: manifest count invariant validated keys by string coincidence and hardcoded m04_created — now generic over *_created blocks with every int count asserted positive.
W7: dead code removed (identical _quantity_before branches, 'if True:' in grammar_date, no-op if/else in training._envelope).
S1: from_config now raises on unknown profile/locale so app.py logs normalization.policy_invalid and degrades explicitly (never silent re-direction).

S9: policy_revision hashes canonical policy-file content, not the revision string — edited tables can never share a revision id.
S10: same-span ambiguity now triggers on differing outputs regardless of class, matching the contract comment.

findings_deferred: DB1-S4: numbers with quote glyphs glued to the word ('"twelve' tokens) stay unconverted while spaced quotes convert — safe direction, no corruption; revisit with M07 cleanup interplay.
